ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between ~75% high-intensity (white/light gray) surface area and ~25% low-intensity (black) border/mottling regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density black pigmentation localized along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant black mottling and focal spotting clustered at the fluke-to-peduncle junction and radiating outward across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (peaks and valleys) spanning the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to a sharp, convex distal tip on the left lobe and a blunt, jagged distal tip on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, curvilinear and parallel rake marks visible on the right lobe surface and near the central notch, breaking the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; series of distinct parallel vertical scars (rake marks) on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
